title: ChartMetricsBinding
description: Metrics binding for a dynamic chart. A binding should use exactly one of queryPlan, intent, or capabilityRef; services validate that rule because OpenAPI generator support for oneOf object constraints is weak.

queryPlan.description: Direct validated query plan authored by telemetry-agent.

intent.description: Curated metrics intent identifier for current compatibility paths.

capabilityRef.description: Future stable capability reference. Runtime support is not required in Phase 1A.

selectors.description: Product-level selectors such as siteId, deviceId, targetId, or interface. These are not backend label matchers.

seriesLabelFields.description: Preferred response label fields used to build the chart series name.

unit.description: Display unit for the chart value.
